description: An east platform across a 96u pit under a 90u ceiling, reached only by a plain (unlifted) jump arc: every lifted duck-jump twin's crouched hull tops out at 93.33u and is ceiling-blocked, so the pair's kept arc is the plain one (#115).

must_visible.why: control: the corridor's east end wall, seen along the corridor from the spawn
control: the pit floor, seen from a platform edge and landed on
control: the corridor's ceiling over the spawn

must_reach.why: east platform: across the 96u pit the pair's kept arc is the plain (unlifted) jump, every lifted duck-jump arc being blocked by the 90u ceiling (hull top 93.33)
pit floor: a drop from either platform

notes: Ceiling z=90: a lifted arc's hull top 93.33 (blocked), a plain one's 57.33 (free), so the pit is crossed only by a plain arc.  A running jump cut by the ceiling crosses the pit with 13u to spare by vmfgen's overhang model; a standing jump reaches at most 48u (its open-air bound; less under this ceiling).
